description: Creates the access list entries for the specified organization API key.. Source:- https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources/tree/master/cfn-resources/access-list-api-key

OrgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects

APIUserId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies this organization API key for which you want to return access list entries.

Profile.description: Network address that issued the most recent request to the API.

CidrBlock.description: Range of network addresses that you want to add to the access list for the API key.

IpAddress.description: Network address that you want to add to the access list for the API key.

TotalCount.description: Number of documents returned in this response.
